item.title: Volatile Oil Markets Hint at Prolonged Price Surge
item.description: Oil market volatility signals sustained high prices beyond 2026. With Brent crude hovering around US$100 and futures markets pricing in long-term disruptions, the economic impact could be significant. How will this reshape energy equities and the broader economy?

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Plunge Amid US-Iran Conflict
item.description: Gold and silver prices are reeling from a historic correction as the US-Iran conflict rattles markets. With gold dipping to US$4,100 and silver to US$61, investors are questioning the metals' safe-haven status. Could this be a buying opportunity or a sign of more volatility ahead?

item.title: Australian Senate Supports New Crypto Framework
item.description: Australia's Senate committee backs a new bill to regulate crypto platforms, focusing on licensing and compliance for exchanges and custodians. This could reshape the digital asset landscape by aligning it with traditional financial markets. Want to know how this affects you? Read on for more insights.

item.title: Copper Supply Struggles to Meet AI Infrastructure Boom
item.description: AI's rapid expansion is straining the copper market. New AI data centers, operational in under two years, require far more copper than traditional facilities. Yet, copper mines take 18 years to develop. Can the industry bridge this gap, or will tech progress hit a wall?

item.title: Ucore, Vulcan Unite for US Rare Earth Magnet Supply
item.description: Ucore and Vulcan Elements are teaming up to build a US rare earth magnet supply chain, reducing reliance on China. With Ucore's Louisiana facility and Vulcan's North Carolina site, this partnership aims to reshape the industry. Curious about the future of rare earths? Dive deeper.
